competing_explanation: A pass would show only that a fixed translation-reduced source-utility projection qualifies under this synthetic development measurement. A fail with box reproduction would reject simple raised-cosine taper as sufficient and motivate a separately authorized spatial-unit reconstruction; it would not prove local utility absent or continuous actions necessary. Boundary diagnostics can support but not uniquely identify seam aliasing. No result identifies deployment-visible predictability, physical haze mechanisms, real-domain transport, or perceptual optimality.

intervention.matched_budget: one frozen official ConvIR-B inference per each of 400 nested haze conditions followed by deterministic replay of the same three actions; taper and box fields share every inference and utility table

question: On the isolated 100-scene Haze4K development partition, does a fixed source-only raised-cosine taper projection of conditional three-action GT utility have less than 0.10 dB worst-held-out-grid PSNR regret with adequate precision, matched box reproduction, location specificity, non-clipping direction, and SSIM/color safety?

uncertainty.method: 20,000-resample complete-scene bootstrap for continuous means and two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals for material-benefit and harm prevalences; achieved regret upper-bound distance is reported explicitly
